registered: 2026-10-24 (America/New_York), committed before any Brute v0.1.0 core code; the git commit containing this file is the pre-registration record
mission: research toward general intelligence by making the reasoner refuse what it cannot verify; no AGI claim

parent_study.files_left_frozen: experiments/PLAN.json, experiments/SOURCE_FREEZE.json, all bgr*/ packages and the v0.90 experiment scripts stay byte-identical so study-001 still audits in-tree

heldout_note: new seed blocks; disjoint from study-001 (930001..990024) and from the calibration set
probability_rule: p = (1-epsilon)*p_v090 + epsilon/4, where p_v090 is the v0.90 AdequacyLearner forecast; uniform when the declared family is contradicted. No evaluator floor is needed or used for Brute.

order: family contradicted -> OUT_OF_FAMILY / FAMILY_CONTRADICTED (all earlier certificates in the case are counted as retracted)
family row budget exhausted -> ABSTAIN / BUDGET_EXHAUSTED
family support has more than one code -> POSSIBLE_SET
margin row budget exhausted -> ABSTAIN / BUDGET_EXHAUSTED
margin (<=5 state) support is not exactly the same singleton -> ABSTAIN / MARGIN_DISAGREES
every surviving <=4 row uses all 4 states -> ABSTAIN / BOUND_SATURATED
otherwise CERTIFIED (conditional on the declared family)
certification_rule.public_certificate: CERTIFIED and a valid ScopeAttestation naming the declared family is present and has not been revoked (revoked by retry, contradiction or residual alarm)
certification_rule.attestation_in_study: the evaluator attests the five in_family families by construction; ood5 and drift4 are never attested

residual_surprise.statistic: s_t = -ln(sum of the published forecast probabilities over the codes compatible with the masked observation at step t); R_t = mean of s over the last W observed steps, defined once W steps are observed
residual_surprise.threshold_rule: tau = max R_t over every step of every calibration case, computed with the alarm disabled; alarm when R_t > tau; the alarm is sticky for the rest of the case; it suppresses certification and public certificates but does not change probabilities
residual_surprise.calibration_output: results/study-002/CALIBRATION.json, written and committed before the held-out study is run

criteria.C1_in_family_soundness: Brute conditional false certificates = 0 on every in_family case, all 44 steps including burn-in; public false certificates = 0
criteria.C2_ood5_false_certs_zero: Brute conditional false certificates on ood5 = 0, all steps including burn-in (v0.90 control on the same cases reported alongside)
criteria.C3_drift4_reduction: Brute conditional false certificates on drift4 <= 0.5 x the v0.90 control false certificates on the same cases, all steps; zero is reported as a stretch target, not a gate
criteria.C4_public_safety: zero public certificates on ood5 and drift4; zero wrong public certificates anywhere
criteria.C5_false_alarm_limit: fraction of in_family held-out cases with at least one RESIDUAL_SURPRISE alarm <= 0.05; step-level alarm rate also reported
criteria.C6_open_world_logloss: no published forecast gives any code probability < epsilon/4 (exact check over every step); mean post-burn-in log-loss on ood5 and on drift4 each <= ln 4 = 1.386294
criteria.C7_in_family_logloss_cost: mean post-burn-in log-loss of Brute on each in_family family <= v0.90 control on the same cases + 0.05 nats
criteria.C8_coverage_reported: report (no gate) post-burn-in coverage and selective risk for v0.89 legacy, v0.90 control and Brute, plus the abstention breakdown by status and reason
criteria.C9_row_budgets_reported: report (no gate) peak rows for the <=4 and <=5 learners and the count of budget exhaustions; any exhaustion must produce abstention
criteria.C10_independent_audit: an independent reference (experiments/v90_independent_reference.py, no import of brute) recomputes every <=4 and <=5 support, every Brute decision, every residual statistic and every alarm
criteria.C11_reproducibility: a second run to a new path gives a byte-identical SCIENTIFIC.json (all timing keys stripped)

scoring.v089_logloss: recorded on every step where the v0.89 n<=3 catalogue is still consistent; compared pairwise on those steps
scoring.baselines: uniform (ln 4) and v0.89 suffix-frequency contexts 1/2/4 (alpha 0.7) on every post-burn-in step
scoring.bootstrap: paired, clustered by world seed, 2000 resamples, seed 20261024

deviation_policy: criteria, thresholds, seeds, W, epsilon and caps are fixed by this commit. Any change after results are seen is recorded as a ledger 'deviation' entry with reason, and the original criterion is still reported.
pre_registration_disclosure: before writing this plan a timing probe ran the stock bgr90 SymbolicLearner(5,160000) on six study-001 cases (no test seeds) and looked only at status, peak rows and seconds (max 12809 rows, 0.32 s per case). No certificate or loss numbers were looked at.
limitations: Exactness of the margin gate holds only for worlds with at most 5 states; drift4 is nonstationary and has no such guarantee.
The residual threshold is a calibrated heuristic, not a proof of out-of-family detection.
Scope attestation is a laboratory statement by the evaluator, not secure authorization.
Synthetic two-action, two-bit worlds only; no language, images or open-ended programs.
